scope_note: Selection is based on the connected Library metadata census, targeted semantic retrieval, targeted Google Drive search and authenticated Gmail attachment review. Recursive enumeration of the mounted Google Drive collection is not supported by the Library connector, so the register is an evidence-priority selection rather than a representation that every Drive byte has been substantively read.

publication_classes.FULL_PUBLIC: Publish the complete native document plus searchable text and page images.
publication_classes.FULL_PUBLIC_REDACTED: Preserve the unredacted source privately; publish a complete, separately hashed redacted derivative plus redacted text and images.
publication_classes.PARTIAL_PAGES: Publish specified pages with surrounding context and identify the omitted range.
publication_classes.EXCERPT_IMAGE_TEXT: Publish a redacted visual excerpt and a searchable transcription, not the full private source.
publication_classes.IMAGE_ONLY_WITH_CAPTION: Publish a source-derived image where text extraction is immaterial or would mislead.
publication_classes.WITHHOLD_PRIVATE: Do not publish; register only a public-safe proposition/hash/custody reference.
publication_classes.DUPLICATE_SUPERSEDED: Do not create another public evidence object; retain deduplication/provenance mapping.

deduplication_rules: Files with the same byte size and filename family, including numbered copies such as 1780049468759_RE_007421_26(n).pdf, are one candidate family until SHA-256 proves distinct variants.
A generated summary, translation or report never replaces the native source and is not uploaded as a second primary exhibit.
For each duplicate family select one canonical native object, preserve alternate hashes and creation metadata, and register every derivative as a child.
Do not mirror a Gmail attachment again when an identical public, redacted repository binary and page-image set already exist.
automatic_interlink_rules: Every selected item must link to canonical actor/entity IDs, event IDs, proceeding IDs and at least one reader-facing route.
Every page image must carry parent evidence ID, page number, source hash, derivative hash, redaction status and caption.
Every excerpt must preserve enough preceding/following context to avoid changing meaning and must identify omitted material.
Every current/legacy hash pair remains separate until byte-level comparison explains the difference.
